title: [RB-001] Pin Godot toolchain and initialize repository
acceptance_criteria: A clean checkout imports on a second workstation or clean runner. | No generated cache, signing secret, Flutter project, or mandatory Kotlin dependency is committed. | Repository documents the exact engine/export-template pairing.

title: [RB-002] Select physical Android test matrix
acceptance_criteria: At least three actual devices are identified with owners/access. | Proposed minimum Android support is marked unapproved until tests pass. | Bluetooth, interruptions, and notch/navigation conditions are represented.

title: [RB-003] Benchmark Mobile and Compatibility renderers
acceptance_criteria: Decision includes measured p95/p99 data, not only average FPS. | Target/low tiers are named with limitations and renderer-specific concerns. | No renderer switch is hidden inside an ordinary graphics-quality toggle.

title: [RB-004] Validate Jolt ball, ramp, and collision behavior
acceptance_criteria: No unacceptable tunneling in the diagnostic power range. | A repeatable resting/rolling approach is documented. | Selected engine, tick rate, and tuning version are recorded.

title: [RB-005] Prove mic permissions and hardware release lifecycle
acceptance_criteria: No app-level audio recording or upload exists. | Capture never routes audible microphone sound to speakers. | Hardware release result is documented; failures block voice release rather than being relabeled. | A Kotlin evaluation occurs only if supported engine behavior cannot meet the requirement.

title: [RB-006] Approve MVP flows and reconcile concept mockups
acceptance_criteria: No hearts, shop, daily challenge, gems, or voice-score metric in MVP requirements. | Every essential denial/cancel/loading/save error has a planned path. | PRD and UI spec precedence over mockups is explicit.

title: [RB-007] Implement typed shot, score, and tuning domain contracts
acceptance_criteria: Touch and Voice have one curve with identical constants. | Boundary tests cover p=0, p=1, invalid numbers, and star thresholds. | No UI, audio, or physics-node dependency exists in pure math functions.

title: [RB-008] Implement authoritative gameplay state machine
acceptance_criteria: Duplicate release produces at most one shot/stroke. | Background before physics commit cancels without a spent stroke. | Only GameSessionController writes stroke totals and result state.

title: [RB-009] Create level wrapper and scene-marker contract
acceptance_criteria: A minimal scene loads by validated ID. | Missing required markers produces an actionable validation error. | Reimported art does not overwrite gameplay nodes.

title: [RB-010] Implement ball impulse and rolling resistance
acceptance_criteria: Physics rate stays fixed at 60 Hz across quality tiers. | Flat roll distance is measured at four powers. | No per-frame impulse multiplication or nonuniform collider scaling.

title: [RB-011] Implement playfield aiming and input ownership
acceptance_criteria: Dragging a UI control never changes world aim. | Aim locks during capture and shot commit. | Narrow-screen gestures remain usable with one thumb.

title: [RB-012] Implement complete Touch shot controls
acceptance_criteria: Touch can complete the graybox hole with mic permission denied. | Same input value yields the shared impulse with no bonus/penalty. | Shoot is unambiguous and never fires from slider release alone.

title: [RB-013] Implement Ready, Follow, and Overview cameras
acceptance_criteria: Ball and target remain clear of HUD in reference sizes. | Overview cannot be used to exploit unpaused hazard timing. | Falling camera does not dive into the void.

title: [RB-014] Implement support, rest detection, and safe anchors
acceptance_criteria: A midair apex or slowly sliding slope does not become Ready. | Ball can settle reliably on intended turf. | Unsafe/blocked anchors fall back to an authored checkpoint.

title: [RB-015] Implement out-of-bounds and stuck recovery
acceptance_criteria: One fall adds exactly one penalty in addition to the committed shot. | Repeated trigger events cannot create repeated penalties. | Blocked safe anchor uses fallback; confirmed recovery does not silently erase score.

title: [RB-016] Implement cup capture and completion ownership
acceptance_criteria: Slow valid entry completes once. | High flyover, fast pass, and underside entry do not win. | Animation signals cannot duplicate a result.

title: [RB-017] Implement stars, attempt limits, and unlock rules
acceptance_criteria: Par/par+1/par+2 produce 3/2/1 stars for valid completion. | Eleven strokes plus shot plus fall resolves thirteen and fails. | One-star CC06 unlocks PP01 and Panda.

title: [RB-018] Build shared Godot UI theme and safe-area shell
acceptance_criteria: No full-screen screenshot is used as interactive UI. | Targets meet the proposed logical size and text is not baked into art. | Safe-area tests pass at narrow/tall/notched sizes.

title: [RB-019] Implement mode choice and contextual permission UX
acceptance_criteria: Fresh boot and Touch flow do not prompt for microphone. | Denied permission still allows all gameplay. | Permission result is not confused with a synchronous return value.

title: [RB-020] Implement bounded VoiceInputService and silent monitoring
acceptance_criteria: No microphone sound is audible through output. | Old frames cannot power a new capture session. | No file/network/log path receives PCM.

title: [RB-021] Implement room/soft/strong calibration
acceptance_criteria: Too-noisy or too-small range shows recovery/Touch, not forced louder prompts. | Soft and strong can be achieved comfortably on test devices. | No hardware identifier or audio recording is stored.

title: [RB-022] Implement preview power and stable release selection
acceptance_criteria: Preview-to-command difference is <=0.01 for accepted releases. | A single transient/no-signal hold cannot launch. | Frame-jitter and stale-buffer fixtures pass.

title: [RB-023] Connect hold/release/cancel voice gestures
acceptance_criteria: One valid release adds one stroke and impulse. | Cancel and >3 second hold never auto-fire. | Secondary touches and UI navigation cannot create unintended shots.

title: [RB-024] Handle pause, background, route changes, and scene disposal
acceptance_criteria: Privacy indicator and capture ownership tests pass on target devices. | Returning during a prior hold cannot launch a shot. | Thirty game entry/exit cycles leave one live session at most.

title: [RB-025] Implement game audio ducking and nonverbal feedback
acceptance_criteria: The game cannot power itself from its own UI/mascot sound in normal tests. | Muted players can complete using visual cues. | All audio has recorded provenance and no user voice clips.

title: [RB-026] Pass one-hole end-to-end playable-loop gate
acceptance_criteria: A denied-mic install still completes and saves the hole. | Voice path shows correct preview/stroke/cancel behavior. | No critical physics, capture-release, or progress-loss defect remains for the slice.

title: [RB-027] Create lion mascot production asset and expressions
acceptance_criteria: Lion reads clearly at gameplay size. | Collider, mass, and shot tuning are unchanged by the art. | Asset source, license/provenance, and triangle/material counts are recorded.

title: [RB-028] Create modular course kit and collision wrappers
acceptance_criteria: Module seams do not trap or bounce the ball unexpectedly. | Reimports preserve wrapper interactions. | Budget and provenance inventory covers all modules.

title: [RB-029] Establish mobile lighting, materials, and quality tiers
acceptance_criteria: No quality tier changes physics, collider, tick rate, or scoring. | Representative scene meets selected target budgets or records a blocker. | Low quality preserves cup/gate/portal clarity.

title: [RB-030] Implement Home and loading/error navigation
acceptance_criteria: Home does not prompt for mic or show unimplemented shop/daily controls. | Loading errors return safely without duplicate sessions. | Buttons are accessible real Controls with pressed/disabled states.

title: [RB-031] Implement two-world twelve-hole selection
acceptance_criteria: All unlock states match domain tests. | One-star completion advances progression. | No shop/hearts/lava-world scope appears as an active feature.

title: [RB-032] Polish calibration UI and recovery states
acceptance_criteria: No automatic capture on mere screen navigation. | Denied/no-input/noisy/route-changed states have a recovery path. | No SPL claims or pressure to scream.

title: [RB-033] Polish Ready/Capturing/Rolling gameplay HUD
acceptance_criteria: Cup/ball/landing area are not hidden by decorative logo or HUD. | Rolling state does not display misleading mic activity. | Input fallback and Overview are discoverable.

title: [RB-034] Implement Pause, Settings, and Android Back behavior
acceptance_criteria: Resume never starts mic automatically. | Back dismisses sheets before exiting gameplay. | Volume/haptics/reduced-motion/quality/input settings persist.

title: [RB-035] Implement truthful results and save-warning UI
acceptance_criteria: No whisper %, accuracy %, gems, or time-based rank is shown. | Final hole routes to map/completion instead of a missing next scene. | Save failures are visible and previous durable progress stays safe.

title: [RB-036] Approve one polished visual and interaction slice
acceptance_criteria: Approval includes real-device gameplay video and frame timings. | Buttons, ball, input meter, and camera are functional rather than image overlays. | Major control/readability issues are resolved or block content scaling.

title: [RB-037] Implement moving gate obstacle
acceptance_criteria: Pause/resume does not teleport the obstacle. | Low-speed contact and fast impact are stable. | Gate can be reused by multiple holes without copied logic.

title: [RB-038] Implement paired portals and exit validation
acceptance_criteria: One pair preserves allowed speed and maps direction as designed. | Ball cannot repeatedly teleport while inside an exit. | Invalid pair/blocked exit fails validation or safely rejects entry.

title: [RB-039] Implement one-shot bounce pad
acceptance_criteria: One eligible entry produces one impulse. | Remaining inside the trigger does not continue acceleration. | Pad effect remains readable in reduced quality/motion.

title: [RB-040] Author and validate Cloud Cliffs holes 1–3
acceptance_criteria: Each of three holes has an independent successful route record. | Primary early routes have forgiving power bands rather than single exact values. | Metadata status changes only with attached evidence.

title: [RB-041] Author and validate Cloud Cliffs holes 4–6
acceptance_criteria: All three holes are independently completed in the pinned build. | No inevitable gate trap or inaccessible reset location. | World completion unlock behavior matches PRD.

title: [RB-042] Author and validate Portal Peaks holes 1–3
acceptance_criteria: Each hole has its own teaching focus and completed route. | No invisible teleport destination or mandatory exact-volume trick. | Safe recovery works after misses.

title: [RB-043] Author and validate Portal Peaks holes 4–6
acceptance_criteria: All final holes are independently solved on the pinned build. | PP06 completion ends cleanly and equips only earned cosmetics. | No unavoidable precision beyond tested intended difficulty.

title: [RB-044] Implement three cosmetic balls and collection screen
acceptance_criteria: All cosmetics use identical physics resources/collider settings. | Locked preview cannot be equipped. | No rarity, purchase, currency, or random unlock subsystem is required.

title: [RB-045] Implement validated local progress/settings and recovery
acceptance_criteria: Worse replay/duplicate completion never erases a best result. | Truncated/future-schema/invalid values fail safely. | Failure at each write step preserves a valid prior durable copy where available.

title: [RB-046] Implement content catalog and scene validators
acceptance_criteria: Design-only catalog cannot be mislabeled production-validated. | Missing scene or marker fails the shipping build gate. | Every error reports level ID and actionable detail.

title: [RB-047] Run all-hole playtest and balance review
acceptance_criteria: Each hole has independent completion evidence and approved par. | Full Touch run earns the same rewards as Voice. | No critical unfair trap, hidden target, or unexplained failure remains.

title: [RB-048] Conditional: add narrowly scoped Kotlin input/platform adapter
acceptance_criteria: Absent plugin preserves functional Touch/default supported path. | Two-device tests prove the original gap is fixed with no second input owner. | No gameplay, UI, score, or cloud audio service is moved into Kotlin.

title: [RB-049] Externalize strings and prepare English/Indonesian localization
acceptance_criteria: No important instruction exists only in a texture. | Missing keys are detected automatically. | No clipping or mixed-language accidental fallback in selected locale.

title: [RB-050] Verify accessibility, reduced motion, and equal Touch path
acceptance_criteria: All content/rewards accessible without microphone. | Color/audio/haptics are not the sole carrier of critical instructions. | No unsupported blanket accessibility compliance claim is made.

title: [RB-051] Build automated domain/state/scene regression suite
acceptance_criteria: Tests fail intentionally when a contract is broken. | Synthetic success is not reported as a passed hardware/GPU test. | CI commands/toolchain are pinned and documented.

title: [RB-052] Profile and optimize sustained mobile performance
acceptance_criteria: Selected tiers meet agreed p95/p99/memory/thermal gates or block release. | Repeated levels do not show unbounded resource growth. | Optimizations do not change collision, tick rate, power, or score.

title: [RB-053] Audit privacy, permissions, storage, and dependency provenance
acceptance_criteria: No PCM/transcript/audio upload or production amplitude history. | Hardware capture lifetime matches honest UI copy. | Asset/dependency licenses are recorded and no signing secret is committed.

title: [RB-054] Run mobile interruption and navigation stability suite
acceptance_criteria: No critical crash, accidental shot, lingering capture, or progress-loss defect. | Background never advances gate phase or spends a pending shot. | Recovery copy and actions work in the release-like build.

title: [RB-055] Create reproducible signed Android release candidate
acceptance_criteria: No production secrets are in Git or the handoff package. | Release build, not only debug, passes critical smoke tests. | Artifact version and source commit are traceable.

title: [RB-056] Prepare store materials, policy review, and asset/name clearance
acceptance_criteria: Store claims match implemented offline/voice behavior. | Publisher has recorded audience/name/license decisions. | No compliance/approval guarantee is asserted from this checklist.

title: [RB-057] Approve MVP release gate and hand over operations
acceptance_criteria: No unresolved critical/major issue without explicit release decision. | Release source/artifact/tests are traceable. | MVP scope is completed without conditional/later work silently claimed.

title: [RB-058] Later: evaluate standalone iOS export and audio lifecycle
acceptance_criteria: No claim that Kotlin solves iOS integration. | Physical iOS capture/lifecycle evidence precedes feature parity claims. | New platform work has approved scope.

title: [RB-059] Later: evaluate wind/lava worlds and daily challenges
acceptance_criteria: Separate approved PRD defines new content and regression impact. | New mechanic does not compromise comfortable Voice/Touch parity. | No new world is marketed before actual validation.

title: [RB-060] Later: review online analytics or monetization as separate scope
acceptance_criteria: No network/account/ad/payment feature is added without an approved review. | Touch/Voice parity is preserved. | Data claims and dependencies are audited before shipping.
